title: Audience and Source Question Strategy

notes.html:
Audience Question Examples

  • The passages most strongly suggest that both are targeting an audience that is interested in which one of the following?

  • Given the style and tone of each passage, which one of the following is most likely to correctly describe the expected audience of each passage?

Source Question Examples

  • The passages were most likely taken from which one of the following pairs of sources?

  • Given its tone and content, from which one of the following was the passage most likely drawn?

  • Information in the passage most strongly supports which one of the following inferences regarding the text that this passage introduces?
